notes: Downloads queue their own validated staging folder directly, without a global Intake scan.
Playlist selections share one staging folder and transfer job; failed or unfinished members block the group until retried or explicitly removed.

Source URLs, playlist identity and processing outcome persist in media manifests. Download history exposes transfer state and eventual destination. Intake retry avoids downloading completed media again.
Adds regressions for direct folder queueing, playlist completion and failed-member removal, playlist staging, provenance preservation and destination history.
